credit.notes: Email: subject 'BLOCKCC <Last6>' to blockchannels@canarabank.com from registered email. Canara ai1 app + NetBanking also available.

debit.notes: Canara ai1 app: Debit Card > Block/Freeze. NetBanking also available. Email: subject 'BLOCKDC <Last6>' to blockchannels@canarabank.com from registered email.

upi.notes: Emergency freeze: from your registered e-mail id send subject 'BLOCKUPI <Space> <Mobile Number prefixed with Country Code>' (e.g. 'BLOCKUPI 911234567891') to blockchannels@canarabank.com, or 'block the channel by calling our 24*7 Toll free number: 1800 1030'; unblocking needs a branch visit ('Kindly visit the home branch for unblocking the accounts after blocking through email'). In-app: Canara ai1 app 'Profile > De-Register > Select Mobile Banking, UPI or Both > Continue'; lost handset — report to nearest branch, 'Toll Free Helpline 18001030 can also be used for blocking the Mobile Banking / Accounts'. Canara ai1Pe UPI app: 'What if UPI shows Blocked/Frozen? Customer must contact respective Bank/branch where debit account is maintained'; lost phone — 'Block your mobile number immediately... Contact your Bank customer support immediately'; withdraw consent via Settings > 'Deregister/Revoke Your Consent'; branch support ai1pe@canarabank.com, customers: toll free 1800 1030. No netbanking UPI-manage path and no SMS/*99# keyword published on the pages checked; app links above are the bank's developer listings — bank pages say to search 'Canara ai1' / install ai1Pe from the Play Store / App Store.
